summary: Frontend-only re-verification of iteration_1 UI fixes on mobile viewport 390x844 (Playwright, public preview URL). Verified: header icon visibility/UA-border reset, avatar solid background, card border/padding/background, outside-click dropdown behavior for both notifications and user menu, mobile dropdown viewport fitting, initials sanitization, page navigation (/profile,/history,/tournaments,/aita-rankings,/player-dashboard), console cleanliness, touch-target sizes and horizontal scroll. 12 of 14 requested checks PASS. Two issues remain: initials sanitization was NOT applied to PlayerDashboardShell (shows 'M(' for 'Madhu (Parent)'), and heavy Vite dev-module 429 rate-limiting caused a fully blank white page on one navigation run.

ui_bugs.issue: initials() at src/components/player/PlayerDashboardShell.jsx:20-24 does not strip non-alphanumerics; parent user 'Madhu (Parent)' renders as 'M(' in the hero avatar circle. Same unsanitized logic duplicated in src/components/coach/RosterView.jsx:15, src/components/coach/LeaderboardView.jsx:10, src/pages/ParentDashboardPage.jsx:65 and src/components/nav/MTNavChrome.jsx:55 (single-letter only). Extract one shared sanitized initials util.
Escape key does not close the nav drawer (only overlay click / close button do), while NotificationsBell and user menu both support Escape - inconsistent keyboard UX. No focus trap either.

integration_issues.flow: Rapid multi-route navigation in Vite dev mode
integration_issues.issue: Many /src/**/*.jsx module requests returned HTTP 429 (rate limited by ingress) during back-to-back route changes; one /player-dashboard load rendered a completely blank white page and the subsequent '/' navigation timed out. Reproduced once; the same route loaded fine when navigated in isolation with a pause. Environment/dev-server issue (unbundled ESM waterfall), not app logic, but it makes the app appear broken during fast navigation.

issues: Uses native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy with UA calendar glyph) instead of the app's styled/shadcn date picker; visually inconsistent with the rest of the dark UI
Trophy icon on the 'MATCHES' stat card renders very dark/low-contrast against the dark card compared to the blue/lime icons on sibling cards - verify intended muted color

Optional: add Escape-to-close (and focus trap) to NavDrawer for parity with dropdowns
Optional: replace native date input on /profile Streak Freeze with the app date picker component

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS on mobile 390x844: menu-toggle-btn/notifications-bell/theme-toggle-btn borderWidth=0px, color+svg=rgb(255,255,255), 44x44 hit areas, appearance=none; user-menu-btn bg=rgb(51,112,255) with white 'CR'; Card borderWidth=1px, padding=16px, bg=rgb(26,28,30), backgroundImage=none (expected); notifications dropdown rect x=8 right=382 (fits 390); outside click + Escape close both dropdowns and header buttons stay immediately clickable (no scrim); user menu rect x=126 right=382; documentElement.scrollWidth=390 (no h-scroll); /profile,/history,/tournaments,/aita-rankings load cleanly with solid blue avatars; only React Router v7 future-flag warnings, zero React errors; dashboard skeletons resolve to real values within ~8s. Remaining: PlayerDashboardShell 'M(' initials bug and dev-mode 429 blank-page flakiness.
rca_of_the_issue: Initials sanitization was applied only in AppShell.jsx and TopNav.jsx; PlayerDashboardShell.jsx keeps its own initials() helper that takes parts[0][0]+lastPart[0] without stripping punctuation, so 'Madhu (Parent)' -> 'M' + '(' = 'M('. Blank-page incident RCA: Vite serves each source module as a separate request; rapid route switching triggered ingress rate limiting (HTTP 429) on dozens of /src/*.jsx requests, so the route chunk failed to evaluate and React rendered nothing.
